target.name: Synthetic modal with an automated clean scan

findings.target_and_state: Synthetic modal open with keyboard focus on the obscured page
findings.title: Keyboard focus moves behind the open modal

evidence.description: After the modal opens, pressing Tab moves focus to the obscured page before reaching the modal controls.
evidence.locator: Synthetic modal, open state, first Tab press

reproduction_steps: Open the synthetic modal with the keyboard.
Observe focus move to the obscured page instead of the modal sequence.
findings.user_impact: Keyboard users can lose context and operate controls hidden behind the modal.
findings.recommended_repair: Move focus into the modal when it opens, keep the modal sequence logical, and restore focus to the trigger when it closes.
verification_steps: Repeat the keyboard sequence after repair.
Verify focus remains in a logical modal sequence and returns to the trigger.

evidence_log.description: All bounded deterministic checks passed before manual review.
The required keyboard review reproduced a normative focus-order failure.
